channel.title: Fugitives Caught on Tape
channel.desc: Law enforcement officers pursue fugitives on the run. Troopers engage in the high-speed chase of a wrong-way driver on a motorcycle; Local P-D and a K-9 officer track down a man reportedly in possession of a home-made bomb, Deputies in the multi-state pursuit of an ex-con warn Canadian authorities that their fugitive appears to be heading for the border; and more.
